title: lead-huddle-prep-rapid-fire-actions
content:
Purpose: quick prep for tomorrow's 30m leadership huddle. Keep it tight: 3 decisions, 2 escalations, 4 quick wins. This is a scratchpad — notes to self and owners.

Meeting goals:
- Confirm Dedicated capacity plan for next quarter (decision: authorize +1 pod or defer)
- Approve fallback routing policy for EU region during maintenance windows
- Align on Private deployment go-to-market milestone for pilot customers

Top-level numbers (back-of-envelope):
- Current Dedicated GPU utilization: ~72% (target steady-state 80%). Peak-to-mean ratio this month: 2.1x.
- SLA latencies (p90): Hosted API 210ms, Dedicated 160ms, Private (pilot infra) 220–400ms (varies by site).
- Expected Dedicated uplift if we add +1 pod: +18–22% throughput (depends on batching mix).

Quick context bullets (one-liners to drop in):
- Sales: two mid-market pilots requesting Private by EOW — legal has expedited NDA (Samira).
- Infra: spot contention last week in us-west caused 6% request errors during auto-scaling — SRE mitigated via temporary throttles.
- Product: rollout dashboard now shows token-level cost variance per model route; initial anomalies flagged on older quantized variant.

Decision triggers (what I need to ask during the meeting):
1) Dedicated pod add: commit to +1 pod now vs wait for current billing cycle. Ask: finance can we reallocate reserve? (Owner: Evan)
2) EU fallback policy: accept proposed latency floor (200ms) in maintenance or require stricter failover to US region? Trade-offs: cost vs customer latency.
3) Pilot go/no-go: require SOC2 scoping signoff + at least one signed pilot MSA.

Red-team prompts (to surface risk quickly):
- If we add capacity now, what is the blowback if model demand drops 25% next quarter? (cost buffer?)
- How do we rollback routing policy if a cross-region outage causes auth/token storms?
- Are there data residency checklist items we still need for the EU private prospect? (legal/Security)

Agenda (4 blocks, 30 minutes):
- 0:00–0:05: Quick status (I will call out numbers and incidents)
- 0:05–0:15: Decisions (Dedicated pod + EU fallback + Pilot go/no-go) — call vote and record action owners
- 0:15–0:22: Escalations (SRE incident follow-up, billing ask)
- 0:22–0:30: Wrap: quick wins, parking lot, confirm owners/dates

Prepared one-liners for the meeting (saves time):
- "Dedicated utilization is 72% — adding +1 pod would bring throughput within our ops buffer and reduce p95 latency risk during peak bursts."
- "EU fallback as written keeps customer experience local 95% of the time; trade-off is modest cross-region egress cost during failovers."
- "Pilot needs SOC2 scoping signoff and a signed MSA — otherwise we risk scope creep and legal delays."

Open slide / doc refs to drop in chat if asked:
- quick capacity plot (pull from /metrics/capacity/dedicated-weekly.png)
- incident timeline (link: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/2026-02-auto-scale)

Action items (scratch, short):
- Evan: check finance to confirm whether we can reallocate reserved budget to add +1 pod this cycle. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Samira: confirm NDA status for two pilot accounts + send MSA template to sales lead. Due: 2026-03-13.
- SRE (Alex): produce 1-page root cause for us-west throttle event and mitigation plan for auto-scale. Due: 2026-03-16.
- Legal (Marta): data residency checklist for EU Private pilot — identify any blocking clauses. Due: 2026-03-14.
- Me (Priya): draft fallback policy decision note and post to #exec-leads after huddle. Due: 2026-03-12 (end of day).

Parking lot / follow-ups (non-blocking):
- Revisit quantization recommendation for older model variant after rollout stabilization. Owner: Research.
- Cost experiment: try 75% pre-warmed cache for Dedicated hot routes next week (A/B test). Owner: Platform Eng.

Notes to self (meta prep):
- Keep language binary on decisions (authorize / don't authorize) — avoid soft commitments.
- Call out impacts to customers who are on Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private — three distinct audiences.
- If time runs out, prioritize Dedicated pod decision and legal signoff for pilot.

Tiny checklist before meeting (5 minutes):
- Share capacity plot in chat (done)
- DM Evan and Samira to have them on standby for asks (pending)
- Bring incident 1-pager as backup PDF

Rough follow-up email template (copy-paste after meeting):
"Thanks all for the quick huddle. Decisions: [list decisions]. Owners: [list owners]. Key dates: [list]. Parking lot items: [list]. If you have clarifications, reply-ALL or ping me. -Priya"

End of scratchpad. Will trim down to 6 bullets when sharing as pre-read.
